comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (84.62%) to BmKn2K7 K: 38%, I: 23%, L=F: 15%. Activity: active against S. aureus ATCC 29212 or MRSA (MIC 5 ug/ml), S. epidermidis (MIC 2.5-5.0 ug/ml), E. faecalis (MIC 5-10 ug/ml), E. faecium (MIC 5 ug/ml), and E. coli ATCC 25922 (MIC 5 ug/ml). MOA:bacteria:S. aureus: acted on bacterial membranes. Structure: random coil in water and become helical in 30% or 70% TFE. In vitro toxicity: HC50 > 100 ug/ml. 10% hemolysis at 100 ug/ml, less hemo.lytic. This lysine analog is much less hemolytic than the arginine analog (this study) since arginine is more hydrophobic ( Mishra et al., 2013). In addition, the peptide is not toxic to human HEK293T and mouse fibroblast cells L929. In vivo toxicity:mouse: 80 mg/kg caused 50% animal death. Animal model:mouse: ip infected S. aureus or A. baumannii, 0.5 hpi, IP treated 20 mg/kg, all mice surviced during 7 days observation (ctr group died in 24 h). Thus, the peptide protected mice from death and also reduced CFU in peritoneal fluids.
title: Fine-Tuning of Alkaline Residues on the Hydrophilic Face Provides a Non-toxic Cationic alpha-Helical Antimicrobial Peptide Against Antibiotic-Resistant ESKAPE Pathogens.

comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (84.62%) to Kn2-7 R: 38%, I: 23%, L=F: 15%. Activity: active against S. aureus ATCC 29212 or MRSA (MIC 5 ug/ml), S. epidermidis (MIC 2.5-5.0 ug/ml), E. faecalis (MIC 5-10 ug/ml), E. faecium (MIC 2.5 ug/ml), and E. coli ATCC 25922 (MIC 10 ug/ml). In vitro toxicity: HC50 < 100 ug/ml, hemolytic (see ref). SAR: the peptide activity reduced by 2 fold against Salmonella without C-terminal amidation. However, hemolysis reduced dramatically without C-terminal amidation (HC50 886.50 uM) compared to amidated form Kn2-5R-NH2 (HC50 67.09 uM). ( Mangmee et al., 2021). Hence, Kn2-5R may be of interest for further studies
